name: dlk-nsfw-guard
description: DLK NSFW Cleaner - Telegram bot (Pyrogram). Deploy scaffold for Heroku.

MONGO_URI.description: MongoDB connection string (e.g. Atlas). Provide externally; do NOT store creds in repo.

NSFW_STICKER_LIMIT.description: how many NSFW stickers allowed before mute (default 3)

LOG_CHAT_ID.description: optional: chat id or @username for logs

scripts.postdeploy: echo 'Deployed DLK NSFW Cleaner — configure env vars in Heroku dashboard (API_ID, API_HASH, BOT_TOKEN, MONGO_URI) and scale worker.'
